findings.title: Guard optional prompt-call telemetry inside the failure handler
findings.body: When an engine exposes an ordinary integer prompt_invocation_count but no prompt_calls list, a proposal or repair exception escapes run_episode instead of producing the assigned failure row. This counter-only shape is already supported by ObservedPromptEngine in tests/test_runtime_model_swap.py:1029-1070, and neither attribute is required by EpisodeEngine. Static reproduction (not executed): use that engine shape with a source that increments engine.prompt_invocation_count by one and then raises ValueError('bad offline response'), and supply output_path. The source exception enters this handler, which accesses engine.prompt_calls and raises AttributeError; the finally block charges the delta, but the new exception propagates before decisions are appended or finish() persists the assignment. Guard the optional timeout-detail list independently of the counter so missing telemetry cannot replace the original callback failure and drop the output row.
